_meta.purpose: Provenance for every competitor or third-party claim published on Publishly pages. Pricing comes from official vendor pages. Reliability comparisons also check official help and developer documentation; third-party review themes are labeled as such. Comparison pages render a visible last-checked date.

claims.claim: Ayrshare's published Business plan pricing works out to $1,228.30/mo at 100 profiles ($599 base incl. 30 profiles + 70 × $8.99, monthly billing).
Buffer's published Team rate is $12 per channel on monthly billing and $10 per channel on annual billing — 30 channels cost $360 monthly or $300 on an annual plan.
claims.note: Use $360 for a month-to-month comparison and state the $300 annual-billing equivalent when relevant.

claims.claim: Hootsuite's current self-serve ladder is Standard $99, Professional $199, and Advanced $399 per user per month on annual billing. Standard covers 10 social accounts; Professional and Advanced cover unlimited accounts.
claims.note: Pricing is official. Review-theme counts are third-party observations and must stay clearly attributed to G2; do not present them as an outage rate.

claims.claim: bundle.social's first paid tier is PRO at $100/mo; its free tier covers 3 accounts and 20 posts/mo; paid tiers have unlimited accounts.
Metricool's published tiers run Free / Starter $20–36 / Advanced $53–159 with a 50-brand maximum — no unlimited-accounts tier.
Upload-Post's published plans are $0 / $24 / $50 / $147 / $438 per month for 2 / 5 / 25 / 75 / 225 profiles.
Long-lived Meta and LinkedIn access tokens expire on the order of ~60 days and must be refreshed; TikTok refresh tokens also expire and require re-auth.
claims.note: Use as directional ('tokens on major platforms expire in roughly 60 days'), not per-platform legal precision — full per-platform table belongs to /platforms pages with their own verification.
